release_notes: The traffic log goes Keitaro-style: any click parameter (ad_id, campaign_id, sub_id_N, ttclid...) can be its own column — suggested from parameters actually present in your clicks — and parameter filters (equals / not equals / in list / is empty, up to 5 conditions) drive the page and the CSV alike; the click-log button on a campaign row opens the full log pre-filtered to that campaign, and the table is now the compact tracker-table with per-column fit floors, so full timestamps and long ad-network IDs always read in full. Cost sync explains itself: when spend matches no clicks, Sync Now shows the concrete reason — no spend, no clicks, missing IDs, unreplaced macros or different IDs — with the date and the actual IDs, on one path for Facebook, TikTok and Google. Unmatched cost rows retry on every sync, so late clicks and a newly captured adgroup_id finally land their spend; TikTok's never-filled __CREATIVE_ID__ no longer masks real IDs as the cause, and re-syncing an attributed day no longer reports matched 0. The two-pane campaign editor's tab strip and Streams toolbar now line up at one height, and the partners block syncs with orbitra.link/partners: Helodata, Accsly.io, OpenGSC and Novproxy.
